description: Unit tests for HuffmanBuilder class, verifying Huffman encoding properties and tree serialization.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.NoPrefixCollision
methods.description: Tests that Huffman codes do not have prefix collisions.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.NoMissingInputs
methods.description: Ensures all used characters have representations and no extra are created.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.OptimalCodeOrder
methods.description: Checks that higher frequency characters have shorter or equal length codes.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.ToVector
methods.description: Verifies the byte vector output correctly represents a small Huffman tree.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.ToVectorSingle
methods.description: Tests tree serialization when only one character is used.
